curator: coordinator; post-stop archive curation, not experimental worker quality

privacy_review.scope: Targeted instruction-marker review, not a universal secret scan.

source_modes: Original POSIX modes are recorded per file. Regular local copies match them; locked annex payload permissions differ by normal annex storage. Git records executable status, not every POSIX permission bit.
absence_policy: Only existing capture files are exported. Missing streams or measurements are reported, never synthesized. Empty files are preserved.

captures.stdin: No stdin is reconstructed or invented; only files that actually exist in the source capture are exported
